title: Ultrasound USB acquisition
description: Configure, start and stop UC5-2S acquisition directly with WebUSB. Emits raw USB bytes without a native server.

source.build: TypeScript host service compiled with the site; WebUSB is owned by the host.

behavior: Requires explicit device selection and current phantom setup confirmation. Validates the connected UC5-2S identity, binds the configuration to the current complete PID0, queues IN readers on endpoints6/8/1 and sends the same fixed bootstrap/configuration/Start/Freeze packets as the Rust driver. No retry or further OUT after an uncertain write. WebUSB deadlines close the device; they do not attest acoustic stop. Bounded sessions use duration1–30s and64MiB raw byte limit. An explicit host seconds:null selects continuous reception until Stop/disconnect, with the same bounded IN queues; storage and decoding backpressure belong to the host. No further OUT after an explicit device disconnect. Raw data and configuration remain local.
